card.text: The primary star of an eclipsing pair in the Andromeda Galaxy, one orbit every 2.048644 days.

sources.label: Vilardell et al. (2009)
sources.locator: Vilardell et al. (2010), A&A 509, A70, Table 2: M, R, P and the distance

introduction.text: It has 21.7 solar masses and 9.2 solar radii; its partner has 15.4 and 5.6. The pair gave a direct distance to the galaxy: 724 kiloparsecs.
